Dry-Cooled Modular Reactor and Hyperscale Data Center 96 4.1.3.2 Routt County The last region in the greenfield analysis is that of Routt County Colorado. The potential for large water reactor development in the area seems to be extremely limited, as evidence in Table C.R1. Nestled in the midst of the Rocky Mountains, the vast majority of Routt County exceeds the slope criteria for LWR technology. On its own this criterion makes siting prohibitively difficult. Routt County also has several parks and national forests that dominate its north and eastern boundaries, a sizeable landslide hazard
